findings.detail: fair_value_currency retained the raw XBRL unitRef-style value U_USD even though the source schedule presents fair values in USD.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 repeated single-field currency normalization issue. Raw source table 35 has a Fair Value column with dollar presentation for the flagged investment row, and the schedule total is also dollar-denominated. The stored fair_value_currency value U_USD is therefore not the normalized USD currency expected for BDC fair-value fields.
